## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Concord, United States. It starts at 8111 Concord Mills Boulevard.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Meet the residents of local North Carolina streams, rivers and lakes. Get your hands on rockpool creatures, including sea stars and urchins, and be mesmerized by a school of gliding stingrays. SEA LIFE Charlotte is an ocean of educational experiences!
>
> _Claws_: Come claw to claw with some of the ocean's most amazing crabs. Learn about the crustacean's habitats, and witness the giant isopods, who have four sets of jaws and can grow to over a foot long!
